rows.grounds: numeral specifying petal count in compound with patra
second member of compound describing cakraṃ

items.question: What form and status characterize the sixth cakra in this sequence?
premises: The sixth cakra is identified in the sequence.
This cakra is designated as a king.
This cakra possesses eight petals and a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is a royal eight-petaled wheel with a pericarp.
uncertainties: The intended nuance of rājānam as a metaphorical epithet is contextually inferred.
items.plain_english: But the sixth cakra is the king, having eight petals and a pericarp.
